why: Hong Wang and Joshua Zahl posted a 127-page proof of the Kakeya set conjecture in three dimensions in February 2025, settling the n=3 case (Hausdorff and Minkowski dimension both equal 3); the conjecture for general n remains open.
queries: Kakeya conjecture proved 2025 three dimensions Wang Zahl
